purpose: Small CPU-only data pilot; no model inference or training
selection_rule: First 64 annotations ordered by numeric original filename, without model scores. Development uses the historically indexed 001-006 group; reserve the lowest IDs in the other two conservative groups.
group_basis: Old local metadata is only a conservative grouping hint. Merge ambiguous 2023-05-09/2023-09-05 groups; quarantine invalid-date video012. New ZIP metadata is identical for all 54 videos and conflicts with old metadata. Source independence is NOT established.
holdout_claim: Sequence holdout for D-round tuning only; not a new independent-source or never-seen benchmark. Historical 027/028/054 remain regression-only.
suim_selection_rule: Diver candidates sorted by GT diver area fraction then ID; take 20 evenly spaced ranks. Negative controls use four lowest SHA256(ID) ranks. This is development/regression, not held-out testing.
